story.title: Built by hand, generation to generation
story.founder_line: Built by a family of Licensed Builders
story.image_alt: Inside a home built by the Giaccio family
body: Giaccio Properties was founded on one belief: a home should be built to last, and built to be lived in. Every property in this collection was raised by hand by our family, right here in Westchester County, with the same care we would give our own.
Over the years many of these homes have found their families and moved on. Others are rented and full of life today. And a few are still here, waiting for the right people to walk through the door.
Together they are more than listings. They are two generations of a family's life's work, and we are proud to share them with you.

about.title: Richard Giaccio
body: Giaccio Properties is the family building company behind the homes on this site. Richard Giaccio founded it, and it has stayed deliberately small: one family, building, selling, and renting its own homes across Westchester County, New York.

The collection here runs from Pound Ridge and Bedford to Briarcliff Manor and Katonah. Some of these houses were built and sold years ago. Some are rented and full of life today. A few are still waiting for the right family to walk through the door.
Every home in the collection was raised by the family's own builders, with the same care we would give our own. That standard is the whole business, and it has not changed in two generations.
If you are looking at a particular address, or want to ask about one that is not listed here, write to us. We read every message personally.
